title: Rabbi David Tawil: Life Lessons From Pirke Abot- "Be Truthful to Yourself"

chapters.title: Introduction and Lie Detector Tests
chapters.about: how lie detector tests measure physical responses to lying

chapters.title: Truth and Human Nature
chapters.about: the physical and mental effects of honesty and relationships

chapters.title: The Torah Perspective on Truth
chapters.about: biblical verses and following through on your word

chapters.title: Story from Masechta Yevamot
chapters.about: the story of Rav and how small lies become a habit

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the Torah's perspective on honesty and the importance of being truthful to oneself and others. He discusses how human bodies are naturally hardwired to reject lying, how telling the truth improves health and relationships, and how falsehood becomes a habit even in small matters. The class emphasizes that pretending to be someone else to please others is a damaging form of self-deception.
questions: Why does the body react physically when a person lies?
How does the Torah view telling the truth versus falsehood?
What does the story in Masekhet Yevamot teach us about small lies?
Why is being honest with yourself considered so important?
